issues.detail: Page supplies busy but not loading/error to PageLayout. PageContainer.tsx:135-142 drives its automatic load announcement only from loading/error, not busy/query. Thus this caller does not feed its source loading/failure transitions into that announcement contract. aria-busy does remain wired.
issues.fix: Coordinate an existing page announcement adapter or a page-owned governed announcement for dependent comparisons without passing PageLayout.loading/error in a way that replaces all three independent shells.

states.loading: firmwareImpactState.ts:18-21 identifies pending missing inputs; chart/details keep their shells and skeletons, brief suppresses values. Missing paused initial source is also treated as loading.
states.empty: Resolved [] counts as known input. Brief can show measured zero counts; chart excludes insufficient comparisons; details preserves insufficient rows. Details uses n>0 before showing consumption or deltas so model sentinels are not shown as zero measurements.
states.fatalError: Comparison widgets receive only fatalError; page/source notices and successful source context remain mounted. Retry refetches both histories.
states.refreshError: Retained inputs remain available; state.retained marks either source stale, and named source notices offer recovery for refresh failures.
states.offline: Paused refreshes retain data; initial paused inputs render loading plus named source status where applicable. No simulated offline session.
states.partial: Both actual input histories are required for comparisons; independent DataState payloads and page-level source notices remain.

issues.detail: resolveDataSourceStatus recognizes fetchStatus=paused only without retained data; retained paused sources fall through to ready at line 92. firmwareImpactState.ts:25-27 does mark these inputs retained/stale, and FirmwareBrief.tsx:39-41 shows Retained evidence, but the named source notice alone cannot identify which retained source is paused offline.
issues.fix: For the shared owner, preserve retained data while distinguishing paused refreshes from ready sources and showing independent retry. Coordinate with the existing historical DataState contract; do not add a page-specific competing trust system.

visualIssues.detail: Verdicts use categorical series slots 2/5/7. Current tokens.ts:401 resolves these to amber #f59e0b for better, cyan #06b6d4 for worse, lime #84cc16 for noChange. This is a bright categorical palette rather than the success/danger/neutral semantics already used by details badges. Actual contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse governed restrained semantic verdict colors with better=success, worse=danger and noChange=neutral, preserving every signed bar, zero reference and text/table verdict. Do not change persisted theme or explicit chart choices. Update the existing source-level color assertions only alongside deliberate semantic behavior.

visualIssues.detail: XAxis and YAxis tick sizes are page-local 10 and 11px rather than shared chart presentation roles. Readability under narrow allocation/text scaling is not established.
visualIssues.fix: Consume existing shared chart typography/tick policy while retaining version angle, axis labels and sign; review dense versions at narrow widths rather than dropping versions.

architectureIssues.detail: Details imports LayoutCard directly from layout-reference instead of the public layout category barrel. Slot.tsx:2 also takes useCardPlacement through the reference barrel; public placement availability was not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing @/components/layout LayoutCard export. Resolve placement through its existing supported export before changing Slot; never recreate placement/measurement locally.

architectureIssues.detail: Specialist best/worst formatters stringify Math.round rather than applying the effective locale supplied by formatMetric. Details.tsx:80-100 similarly interpolates rounded values directly, while p and d already use shared number formatting. A translated UI therefore does not localize these numeric displays consistently.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing numeric formatting at the specialist display boundary, retaining fixed Wh/km analysis units, one-decimal delta precision, positive signs and missing marks. Do not replace the source deltas with reciprocal economy, force generic units, or change raw/cache calculations.
